module.name: bases
module.summary: .base query language + BaseView rendering for frontmatter databases.

nodes.label: bases.rs (module)
nodes.summary: Single-file module: parser, evaluator, view models, BaseView renderer.

nodes.label: Lit + Parser
nodes.summary: Expression lexer/parser for filters, formulas, rollup DSL.

nodes.label: evaluator
nodes.summary: Filters/formulas evaluate per note from the frontmatter index.

nodes.label: BaseView
nodes.summary: Entity over a .base or note-scoped spec; subscribes to Document/Vault.

nodes.label: view switch
nodes.summary: Switch table|cards|gallery|kanban|board|calendar views with saved sorts.

nodes.label: Settings::base_views
nodes.summary: Persisted view index + column sorts for each base file.

nodes.label: Document/Vault events
nodes.summary: cx.subscribe_in on Document Changed/Saved updates recompute epoch.

nodes.label: vault entity
nodes.summary: Frontmatter index + file tree feeding every query.

nodes.label: document entity
nodes.summary: Scoped spec inside a note (```bases``` blocks).

nodes.label: workspace shell
nodes.summary: WeakEntity<Workspace> used to open notes and notify like tabs.

flows.name: Open a .base file
flows.summary: Parser reads YAML, evaluates filters per file, view renders results.

flows.name: Edit kanban cards
flows.summary: Card move updates the source note's property, view sniffs the epoch bump.

notes.title: pure-language base layer
notes.body: Expression parser (Lit/Parser) and evaluator are pure and shared: the headless CLI can also report on bases.

notes.title: saved-sort restoration
notes.body: view_ix and (view,column,desc) sorts reconstructed from Settings::base_views during BaseView::new.

notes.title: subscribe-in epoch
notes.body: doc_epoch bumps on DocumentEvent::Changed/Saved and recompiles results while the borrow is still held.
